_doc: Measurement plan for Google Analytics 4 (src/js/analytics.js sends it; tools/ga_setup.py registers the custom definitions and key events in the property). Event names follow GA4's recommended events where one fits (select_content, search, unlock_achievement, earn_virtual_currency, level_start, level_end, post_score, exception). Nothing typed by the visitor is sent, except the DOSBox room's catalogue search (game titles) to GA after consent; never Murray's questions.

select_content.when: a record, studio, engine, demo, interface or hotspot is opened or used

unlock_achievement.when: points are earned (first time for that thing)

game_start.when: a game starts in the DOSBox room

game_end.when: the DOSBox window is turned off or the page is left

game_error.when: a game cannot be downloaded or the emulator does not load

search.when: a search in the DOSBox room's catalogue (1.5 s after typing stops)

murray_question.when: a question to Murray (never its text)

murray_guided.when: Murray takes the visitor to another room or record

language_switch.when: the visitor changes the site's language

outbound_click.when: a link out of the museum

gog_click.when: a link to buy a game at GOG

ui_click.when: any click on a link, button, tab or game screen (where people click)

section_view.when: a section (era, studio, engine, demo) stays on screen 1.5 s

web_vitals.when: when the page is hidden: LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB
